name: managing-coding-denials
description: Analyzes hospital coding denials and DRG and clinical validation denials (DRG downgrades, removed diagnoses, sepsis, inpatient status, 2-midnight) for Medicare fee-for-service, Medicare Advantage and commercial payers, and drafts appeal strategy and letters built on the record as it stood when the claim was billed. Classifies each denial as coding validation, clinical validation, medical necessity or technical so the argument matches it; computes every deadline from its own trigger (redetermination, reconsideration, ALJ, MA reconsideration under 42 CFR 422.582, contract windows, timely filing, Part B rebilling); applies 2026 amount-in-controversy thresholds; screens RAC, MAC and UPIC review limits; tests MA internal coverage criteria under 422.101(b)(6) and 422.138; reads Sepsis-3 or Sepsis-2 from the payer contract; weighs appeal against rebilling; logs peer-to-peer outcomes. Declines to present documentation altered or added after a denial as original. Drafts for coder, CDI and compliance review.
